 From BOGO travel deals to 90% shopping discounts: Your 2026 guide to the 11.11 sale
 By
 Hannah Garzon 
 Published Nov 09, 2026 6:50 pm 
 Add PhilSTAR Life on Google
 Are your wallets ready?
 The 11.11 sale is giving you another chance to score massive discounts on fashion, travel experiences, gadgets, and everyday essentials.
 Whether you're planning your next trip, refreshing your wardrobe, or getting an early start on your holiday shopping, here are some 11.11 deals and promotions to look out for online.

 Shoppers can browse more than 111,000 styles from top brands, with discounts of up to 90%. The sale also features daily flash deals with stackable discounts of up to 11% off on sportswear, shoes, luxury items, and more.
 Those buying multiple items can take advantage of its Buy More, Save More offer, which gives shoppers up to 80% off when they purchase five items, plus an extra 20% off and free shipping.
 Other deals include items priced at P1,111 and below, up to double points for ZALORA Members Club members, and up to P1,000 off with select PNB, BPI, and Security Bank cards, including the ZALORA Credit Card.
 Klook
 Planning a trip? Klook's biggest year-end sale runs from Nov. 9 to 11, with new deals dropping daily at 11:11 a.m.
 Travelers can enjoy up to 20% off hotel bookings, P1,111 off select attractions, and 11% off private transfers. There are also discounts of up to 50% on select activities, tours, and experiences in destinations such as Japan, Taiwan, and Hong Kong.
 The platform is also offering exclusive bank and e-wallet promotions for customers paying with Metrobank, RCBC, and GCash.
 Shopee
 Shopee is welcoming the holiday shopping season with its 11.11 Mega Pamasko Sale, which runs until Nov. 12 and features up to 70% off on select holiday deals.
 You can join the All-Out Mega Cash Panalo campaign for a chance to win up to P2 million, as well as the VIP Shake activity, where you can score up to 1,111 coins.
 The sale also features special offers from Shopee Mall brands across categories such as fashion, beauty, and electronics.
 Lazada
 Lazada's 11.11 Biggest Sale of the Year runs until Nov. 13.
 You can score discounts of up to 90% on LazFlash Deals, along with stackable vouchers worth up to P3,000. The platform is also offering free shipping for shoppers.
 Those looking to shop from established brands can check out LazMall, which offers a 100% authenticity guarantee.
 Looking for other 11.11 deals to enjoy? Check out  PhilSTAR L!fe 's roundups of the best ones in food , tech , travel , and fashion .
